classification: "PARTICLE"                 # PMNS mixing / generation texture = representation-theoretic content of D_K (quantum numbers, mixing angles)
agent_type: "neutrino-detection-specialist"  # PMNS owner / EXECUTOR; gen-physicist contributes the A_K⋊SU(3)_R circulant construction (the substrate-side U_R), neutrino-detection-specialist owns the charged-lepton correction U_L, the U_mix = U_L†U_R assembly, the Jarlskog extraction, and the PMNS-band comparison
hypothesis: "The A_K⋊SU(3)_R right-regular circulant on the LEPTON sector, with the ℂ⊕ℍ charged-lepton-vs-neutrino sector-asymmetry imposed, forces a tri-maximal neutrino texture (|U_ij|²=1/3, J=1/(6√3)=0.09623) whose physical PMNS Jarlskog — AFTER the charged-lepton correction U_mix=U_L†U_R — either SURVIVES near the observed J≈0.033 (⇒ a zero-mixing-parameter prediction of the named external corridor) or is WASHED OUT (⇒ down-tag the lepton resonance to a symmetric-limit coincidence)."

method:
  description: >
    (1) Construct the SU(3)_R right-regular circulant C on the LEPTON multiplicity sector: the 3×3 cyclic
        matrix with w = exp(2πi/3), giving the tri-maximal magnitude |U_ij|²=1/3 and CP phase arg(w)=2π/3
        (B2 Sage-exact; coefficient-INDEPENDENT — the circulant's eigenvector matrix is the DFT matrix
        F₃ up to phases regardless of the c_a coupling coefficients). This is the NEUTRINO-sector mixing
        U_R (the seesaw/right-regular structure).
    (2) Impose the ℂ⊕ℍ charged-lepton-vs-neutrino sector-asymmetry: the charged-lepton mass basis is
        COSET-DIAGONAL (one-circulant-one-coset-diagonal ⇒ tri-maximal per W-2 Q3), so the charged-lepton
        rotation U_L is the diagonal/coset-aligned basis (NOT a second circulant — two circulants would
        give U_mix=identity per W-2 Q3, the quark-sector negative-control case).
    (3) Compute the PHYSICAL misalignment U_mix = U_L† U_R (the PMNS matrix in this corridor).
    (4) Extract the Jarlskog invariant J = Im(U_mix[0,0] U_mix[1,1] U_mix*[0,1] U_mix*[1,0]) and the
        |U_mix,ij|² entries.
    (5) Compute the deviation metric dev = |J_forced(corrected) − J_PMNS,obs| / J_PMNS,obs and compare
        against the pre-registered PMNS 3σ tri-maximal-deviation window.
    (6) NEGATIVE CONTROL: run the SAME machinery on the M₃(ℂ)-shared quark chiralities (both chiralities
        in the M₃(ℂ) leg ⇒ TWO circulants ⇒ assert U_mix → identity ≠ CKM, |U_mix − I| < 1e-12).
    The bare-circulant J_forced = 1/(6√3) = 0.09622504 (Sage-exact, registry-confirmed); the question the
    gate decides is whether the charged-lepton correction (step 2) moves the PHYSICAL J toward 0.033.
  producing_script: "computations/session-115/s115_lepton_pmns_forced_texture.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — the PASS criterion form
operator:
  type: "ratio"
  form: "dev = |J_forced_corrected − J_PMNS_obs| / J_PMNS_obs   compared against the PMNS 3σ tri-maximal-deviation window"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "dev ≤ band_3σ  where band_3σ is the |J_forced − J_obs|/J_obs deviation at which the corrected forced texture's J lands within the observed PMNS 3σ Jarlskog interval [J_obs_low, J_obs_high] (NuFIT/PDG normal-ordering band; pinned in input_files as J_PMNS_obs_low/high). PASS ⟺ J_forced_corrected ∈ [J_obs_low, J_obs_high]"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — the bare-circulant J is analytically exact; the band is observational
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "J_bare = 1/(6√3) = 0.09622504 Sage-exact (registry §VII.CK D4-disposition annotation + this gate's Sage cell); the PASS BAND is the observational PMNS 3σ Jarlskog interval (NuFIT 5.2 / PDG 2024), an external anchor — the gate tests whether U_mix=U_L†U_R lands J inside it"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (the charged-lepton rotation angles are continuous; J_forced_corrected is a continuous function of the coset-diagonal basis). The bare tri-maximal point J=1/(6√3) is an exact algebraic number, NOT rational"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of the producing script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  # --- forced-circulant construction ---
  w_cube_root: "exp(2πi/3)  (primitive cube root; arg(w)=2π/3, Sage-exact)"
  circulant_form: "3×3 right-regular SU(3)_R circulant; eigenvector matrix = DFT₃ (coefficient-INDEPENDENT tri-maximal |U_ij|²=1/3); this is the NEUTRINO-sector U_R"
  coupling_coefficients_c_a: "IRRELEVANT to |U_ij|² and J (the tri-maximal texture is coefficient-independent — a circulant is diagonalized by the DFT regardless of c_a); pinned as 'coefficient-INDEPENDENT' per the B2 Sage-exact result"
  # --- charged-lepton correction (the load-bearing physics) ---
  charged_lepton_basis: "COSET-DIAGONAL (the ℂ⊕ℍ sector-asymmetry: charged leptons live in the coset-diagonal mass basis, neutrinos in the right-regular circulant); one-circulant-one-coset-diagonal ⇒ tri-maximal survives per W-2 Q3 Sage-confirmed"
  charged_lepton_correction_convention: "U_mix = U_L† U_R with U_L = the coset-diagonal charged-lepton rotation (in the SYMMETRIC limit U_L is a permutation/identity-on-the-coset, giving the bare tri-maximal J; the gate computes the PHYSICAL U_L from the ℂ⊕ℍ sector structure and reports both the symmetric-limit J and the corrected J)"
  symmetric_limit_flag: "the SYMMETRIC limit (U_L = coset-identity) reproduces the bare J_forced=1/(6√3); a NON-trivial charged-lepton rotation is what could move J toward 0.033 — the gate decides surviving-vs-washed-out by whether the PHYSICAL (non-symmetric) U_L lands J in the PMNS band"
  jarlskog_form: "J = Im(U[0,0]·U[1,1]·conj(U[0,1])·conj(U[1,0]))  (standard Jarlskog invariant on U_mix)"
  # --- negative control ---
  negative_control: "M₃(ℂ)-shared quark chiralities: BOTH chiralities in the M₃(ℂ) leg ⇒ TWO circulants ⇒ U_mix = C† C = identity; assert |U_mix − I|_F < 1e-12 ≠ CKM (structurally established B2/Q3; re-verified numerically here)"
  # --- numerics ---
  N_eval: "3 (3×3 lepton mixing matrices; closed-form, no sweep)"
  L_max: "N/A — the forced texture is a representation-theoretic statement on the SU(3)_R right-regular action / multiplicity leg, not an L_max-truncated spectral sum"
  scan_range: "N/A — closed-form circulant + coset-diagonal construction (the charged-lepton angles are FIXED by the ℂ⊕ℍ sector structure, not scanned)"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "1e-12 (negative-control identity assertion); the J comparison uses the observational PMNS 3σ band (NOT a tolerance — a pre-registered observational interval)"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "FORCED-CROSSED-PRODUCT-TEXTURE-LEPTON  (the named A_K⋊SU(3)_R external corridor; CONTINGENCY-pinned — tests the corridor's residue, NOT a substrate-internal prediction)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (closed-form circulant + DFT diagonalization)"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (3×3 matrices — far below the 100×100 GPU threshold; cpu-cap-OMP8 via os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','8') before import numpy)"
  publication_precision: "6 sig figs (J_forced = 0.0962250; dev = 1.92477; ratio = 2.92477 — these are cited downstream in the WP and any §EVOI / falsifier annotation)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (the gate pre-registers a SIGN/DIRECTION claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "forced-and-surviving ⇒ the named A_K⋊SU(3)_R corridor makes a ZERO-mixing-parameter prediction of the PMNS Jarlskog; forced-and-washed-out ⇒ down-tag to symmetric-limit coincidence."
    Definition 1: J_forced(bare) = Im of the tri-maximal circulant Jarlskog = 1/(6√3)            [B2 Sage-exact; registry §VII.CK D4-disposition annotation: "Jarlskog J=1/(6√3)=0.0962"]
    Definition 2: J_PMNS,obs    = the observed lepton-sector Jarlskog ≈ 0.0329                    [NuFIT 5.2 / PDG 2024 normal-ordering best fit; EXTERNAL anchor, pinned J_PMNS_obs in input_files — NOT a canonical_constants import; note delta_CP_PMNS_substrate=0 is the SEPARATE substrate seesaw prediction, S100b]
    Definition 3: U_mix         = U_L† U_R, U_R = right-regular circulant (neutrino), U_L = coset-diagonal charged-lepton rotation   [W-2 Q3: one-circulant-one-coset-diagonal ⇒ tri-maximal; two-circulant ⇒ identity]
    Definition 4: dev           = |J_forced_corrected − J_PMNS,obs| / J_PMNS,obs                  [the gate's PASS-metric]
    Substitute:   bare (symmetric-limit, U_L = coset-identity):  J_forced_corrected = J_forced(bare) = 1/(6√3) = 0.09622504
                  dev_bare = |0.09622504 − 0.0329| / 0.0329 = 1.92477   (ratio J_forced/J_obs = 2.92477)
    Simplify:     J_bare = 1/(6√3) = √3/18 = 0.09622504  (Sage-exact, this gate's QQ cell);  dev_bare = 1.92477  (Sage-exact arithmetic on the bare value)
    Direction:    dev_bare = 1.92 ≫ 0 ⇒ the BARE tri-maximal J is ~2.92× the observed PMNS J — OUTSIDE any PMNS 3σ Jarlskog band ⇒ the SYMMETRIC limit FAILS the PASS band. The gate then computes the PHYSICAL charged-lepton correction U_L from the ℂ⊕ℍ sector structure: if the corrected J_forced_corrected lands inside [J_obs_low, J_obs_high] ⇒ SURVIVING (zero-parameter corridor prediction, PASS); if it stays out ⇒ WASHED-OUT (down-tag, the lepton resonance is a symmetric-limit coincidence).
    Conclusion:   the SIGN of (J_forced_corrected − J_PMNS,obs) and whether |that| / J_obs falls within the PMNS 3σ band IS the surviving-vs-washed-out verdict. The bare value alone (dev=1.92) predicts WASHED-OUT absent a large charged-lepton correction; the gate's job is to compute that correction and decide — without iterating toward PASS (the convention is FIXED, the charged-lepton basis is FIXED by the ℂ⊕ℍ structure, not tuned). [The registry's own "lepton-PMNS RESONANT-CONDITIONAL ~2.9× from observed" is the bare-limit shadow of this gate.]

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  forced-and-SURVIVING. The physical PMNS Jarlskog J_forced_corrected = J(U_L†U_R), with U_L the
  ℂ⊕ℍ-forced coset-diagonal charged-lepton rotation, lands inside the observed PMNS 3σ Jarlskog band.
  The named external A_K⋊SU(3)_R crossed-product corridor then makes a ZERO-mixing-parameter prediction of
  the PMNS Jarlskog (the texture is coefficient-INDEPENDENT — no free mixing parameter). Solution-space:
  the lepton resonance is a genuine corridor prediction, NOT a symmetric-limit coincidence; route a
  candidate falsifier row to mack (the corridor's residue becomes a live, zero-parameter PMNS observable).
FAIL_meaning: >
  forced-and-WASHED-OUT. J_forced_corrected stays OUTSIDE the PMNS 3σ band (the bare tri-maximal J=0.0962
  is ~2.92× the observed J≈0.033, and the coset-diagonal charged-lepton correction does not repair the
  gap). The lepton resonance DOWN-TAGS to a symmetric-limit coincidence — the corridor does NOT make a
  surviving zero-parameter PMNS prediction. Solution-space: the named crossed-product corridor's forced
  texture is observationally excluded for the leptons (as it is ~3124× excluded for the quarks); the
  corridor closes the §VII.CK D4 door as external-AS-A-COUPLING WITHOUT a surviving lepton observable.
  This is the expected dual-prior Track-B outcome — informative (closes a corridor), NOT an agent failure.
INFO_meaning: >
  Band-edge or ordering-ambiguous. J_forced_corrected sits at the PMNS 3σ band edge, OR the normal-vs-
  inverted-ordering choice / the |J| sign convention flips the in-band verdict. The corridor's lepton
  residue is MARGINAL — neither a clean surviving prediction nor a clean exclusion; the boundary is
  mapped and the disposition is carried to the next session with the ordering/sign ambiguity named.

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (`CF-S115-VIICK-D4-DISCHARGE-UNCONDITIONAL`) consumes W1-1's output: it re-scopes the §VII.CK D4 door (right-regular SU(3)_R) to CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-COUPLING **on top of** the W1-1 D1-D3 STAGE-3-PERMANENT promotion. Sequencing (per context §"Full 4-field specs" item 2): **W1-1 lands FIRST** (closed-class D1-D3 → PERMANENT, D4-open), **THEN** W2 re-scopes D4 → CLOSED-UNCONDITIONAL. They verify DIFFERENT clauses and are registered as DISTINCT gates — do NOT conflate.

- **W1-1 PASS** (D1/D2/D3 PASS-AND across both axes) → §VII.CK tag flips STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open RETAINED). W2 then proceeds to discharge D4 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL.
- **W1-1 FAIL** (either reviewer FAILs any of D1/D2/D3) → §VII.CK STAYS STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause routes to S116 remediation. **W2 is BLOCKED** — D4 cannot be re-scoped to unconditional on top of an unverified D1-D3 closed class. (W2's plan must carry this as its upstream-block decision point, honest-closing per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` if W1-1 did not PASS.)
- **W1-1 INFO** (either reviewer INFOs a clause) → §VII.CK STAYS STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; Stage-2-INFO-deferred. W2 proceeds at orchestrator discretion only if the INFO clause is not load-bearing for the D4 discharge (the D4 leg rests on D3 leg-membership + the commutant/selection-rule argument — if D3 is the INFO clause, W2 is blocked).

**W1-2** is INDEPENDENT of W2 — it tests the corridor's lepton residue, not the genus closure. W1-2's outcome (surviving/washed-out) does NOT gate W2 (which closes the D4 door regardless of whether the lepton residue survives observationally — externality-as-a-coupling is a structural statement, the PMNS texture is its phenomenological shadow).
